acquisition_method.evidence: All measurements were performed in DDA mode on a Q Exactive HF.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Tissue samples were homogenized and digested with Trypsin.

enrichment_method.evidence: For the tissue atlas, protein digests (1 mg) for all 30 tissue types were divided into full proteome and phosphoproteome samples using IMAC enrichment and further off-line fractionated (full proteome: 24 fractions, hydrophilic strong anion exchange chromatography; phosphoproteome: 4 fractions, basic reversed-phase chromatography).
